author: mark
text:
v0.5 UI: live streaming text for in-flight model calls

Extends the git-tree view-model and renderer to surface the harness's
JSONL response.json (§4.4) as accumulated text on the in-flight branch
row, per ARCH §3.5 and §7.1.

- New `git_tree::streaming` module: pure-function reader that finds the
  highest-NNN step under <conv-repo>/steps/<conv-id>/, reads
  response.json, and folds `text_delta` events into a string. Re-derived
  on every from_repo call; no in-memory accumulator (PRINCIPLES "stateless
  re-read"). Tolerant of partial mid-write lines.
- ConversationBranch gains `streaming_text: Option<String>`; populated
  by enumerate_in_flight from the new reader.
- Renderer wraps streaming text in an indented label below the in-flight
  branch row.
- Test fixture: `write_response_events(conv_id, seq, events)` seeds a
  partial response.json from raw JSONL lines (no harness binary needed).
- Renderer-output tests assert the streaming text reaches the paint
  layer (Shape::Text galley walk) — given an in-flight branch with
  text X, the rendered widget contains X.

100% coverage; clippy clean; ARCH §3.5/§4.4/§7.1 align with shipped
shape (no doc edits needed; the spec already pinned response.json as
the streaming target post v0.3.1 P3).
